what_these_commits_are: Atomic, reviewed commits, each with explicit paths staged. They are NOT incremental recovery points taken while the work progressed: the session began at 04:16 UTC and each commit was created once its unit of work was complete and validated. An independent critic raised this (F-10) and the description is corrected here rather than left implied.
self_reference_limit: This record is written before the commit that publishes it, so that commit is necessarily absent from the list above. It is exactly ONE commit, the last of the session, whose purpose is to carry this regenerated record, evidence-manifest.json, review-audit.json and the final validation results, plus the closure of audit finding A-01. Its SHA is recoverable with 'git log --oneline dc0d3f5..HEAD'. History of this declaration: the first version omitted one commit without saying so (flagged by the evidence checker); the second claimed only the final commit was absent when two were (audit finding A-04). This third version states the count explicitly: 8 commits listed, one not listed.
distinction: A checkpoint is a recoverable commit of work. It is NOT an acceptance, NOT an audit PASS and NOT an authorization. None of these commits closes a change: sc-02 through sc-10 remain BLOCKED in changes.json, which was not modified in this session.
